name: Complimentary Hot Scrambled Eggs & White Toast with Jelly
whyItWorks: Standard hotel breakfast steam-table scrambled eggs (prepared without whole milk or cream) alongside a couple of lightly toasted white bread slices with seedless grape jelly provide easily digestible, safe protein and gentle fuel on the road.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Take freshly replenished scrambled eggs from the buffet. Toast white bread, add a dab of butter or seedless jelly, and bypass spicy sausage links, bacon, and breakfast burritos.
